title: Cancel a forgotten Vistaflix plan
goal: Cancel the Vistaflix plan with id {{planId}} on the user's account so it does not renew. Do not pause it and do not accept any discount or retention offer.

planId.description: Vistaflix plan id, e.g. vf-plan-premium or vf-plan-basic

hints.hint: Open Account from the top navigation to see the plans and their status.
Cancelling is under Settings, then Manage plan for this plan id.
Click Cancel plan. A pause offer appears: choose the option that continues to cancel, not pause.
A 50% retention discount is offered: decline it.
A survey asks why: pick 'not watching enough' and continue.
The final Confirm cancellation button is low contrast. It is irreversible: request approval first.

evidenceCheckpoints.description: Account page showing the active plan
